hoursNote: SOURCES DIFFER — how long? PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTABase say roughly 200 hours (60–80 story, ~100 checklist, 10–20 cleanup). Push Square's intro says 'up to 300 hours or more'. ofzenandcomputing puts the story at 50–60 hours, not 60–80. Our call: plan 200 hours for the checklist route; budget 200–300 if you play at a relaxed pace.
saveNote: There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so saves are your only safety net. The game supports 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave. Keep a save at the start and end of each chapter (10 saves) and rotate the remaining 5 for free-roam cleanup. Never enable cheats on your platinum save: cheats disable trophies and saving, and GTABase and TechWiser say the only fix is a clean save.

stages.note: Play the story in order and start every questline the moment it unlocks. The ONLY possibly missable moment in the game is in this stage: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude. Do it first, then keep a chapter-end save before every finale.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) so every profile action shows on screen.
The morning after Down to Earth (Chapter 1), meditate with Lucia on the balcony — then keep a Chapter 1 save.
Do Cal's fishing challenge after Feng Shui and start Kenton's dives after Island Dreams.
Scan every vehicle and animal you pass with WAiNK and the binoculars — 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals are needed later.
Complete optional missions as they appear — you need any 100 for the 100% checklist, and there are far more than 100 in total.
Save at the start and end of every chapter; there is no mission replay.
stages.title: Story + questlines

stages.note: Free roam after the credits. Work the 100% checklist line by line — the trophy targets and the checklist targets differ on purpose, so the checklist table below shows both. Nothing on the checklist is missable.
steps: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work it line by line; progress from the story already counts.
Finish all robberies first: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults.
Collect in passes: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 flamingos.
Race and shoot: 30 of 40 races won, 42 shooting range gold medals, 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts.
Finish 70 of 80 challenges — skip the 10 hardest — and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
A Long Road pops when the checklist hits 100%; it is usually the last trophy before the platinum.
stages.title: The 100% checklist

stages.note: Finish the remaining stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks, sweep up anything left, and the platinum pops with the last one. 10 hours if you did the strands along the way; up to 20 from scratch.
steps: Complete the 8 qualifying stranger strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count.
Sweep any remaining one-off trophies: the UFO, the tank, the showroom, the cocktail, the bike kicks.
Check the tracker: the platinum pops with the last trophy earned.
stages.title: Strangers & cleanup
